title.covidence: Findings from the First Malawi TB Prevalence Survey
bacteriological.tb.definition:
Definition is based on the following categorization: 
1. Significant Direct Evidence: 
a. S+ (4AFB or more) with “GXP+ and/or C MTB+ (any)” 
b. C MTB+ (5 colonies or more) 
2. Non-significant Direct Evidence: 
a. S+ (1-3 AFB) with GXP+ ( GeneXpert ) and/or C MTB+ 
b. C MTB+ (1-4 colonies) 
3. Supportive Bacteriological Evidences: 
a. S+ (any) without GXP test 
4. Supportive CXR Evidence: 
a. CXR TB disease suggestive or consistent by the panel 
Thus, a bacteriologically confirmed ( positive )case with at least one of following conditions is defined as bacteriologically confirmed( positive )TB patient in this study: 
• At least one sample showed one Significant Direct Evidence 
• Both samples showed Non-significant Direct Evidences 
• At least one sample showed Non-significant Direct Evidence and the other sample has one Supportive Bacteriological Evidence 
• At least one sample showed a weak Direct Evidence and the panel has one Supportive CXR Evidence
